resourcePolicyAuthority: ToolDefinition.ExecutionPolicy (组合 Timeout + Concurrency + Retry + ResourceLimits)

resourceGateAuthority.name: ResultValidator (enforces MaxOutputBytes post-execution)
resourceGateAuthority.note: 当前唯一主动 enforce 的 Resource Gate; 仅作用于输出大小且是执行后检查

runtimeEnforcementAuthority.javascript: JS Supervisor 执行 ResourceLimits.MaxMemoryMB + SingleCallTimeout
runtimeEnforcementAuthority.others: 非 JS 运行时暂无通用资源执行
